Common.name: Abyssal Kingshark
Common.desc: Once per turn, if this card would be destroyed by an effect that does not target it, it is not destroyed.

Common.name: Black Salvo
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 DARK Machine-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but its effects are negated.

Common.name: Darkness Neosphere
Common.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 1 Fiend-Type monster you control and 1 Fiend-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard when your opponent's monster declares an attack. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn, you can return all face-up Trap Cards you control to the hand.

Common.name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Miracle Fusion
Common.desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or your GY.

Common.name: Royal Command
Common.desc: Flip monsters' effects cannot be activated, also their effects are negated.

Common.name: Seven Tools of the Bandit
Common.desc: When a Trap Card is activated: Pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Shield Crush
Common.desc: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Spirit of the Six Samurai
Common.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

Ultimate Rare.name: Colossal Fighter
Ultimate Rare.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
This card gains 100 ATK for every Warrior-Type monster in any Graveyard. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Warrior-Type monster in either Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

Rare.name: Cyber Eltanin
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing all LIGHT Machine monsters from your field and GY. This card's ATK/DEF become the number of monsters banished for its Special Summon x 500. If this card is Special Summoned: Send all other face-up monsters on the field to the GY.

Rare.name: Escape from the Dark Dimension
Rare.desc: Target 1 of your banished DARK monsters; Special Summon that target. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target, and if you do, banish it. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

Rare.name: Puppet Plant
Rare.desc: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Rare.name: Torrential Tribute
Rare.desc: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Rare.name: Wulf, Lightsworn Beast
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect. If this card is sent from your Deck to the GY: Special Summon it.

Rare.name: Zoma the Spirit
Rare.desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap.) If this card Summoned this way is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

Ultra Rare.name: Dark Hole
Ultra Rare.desc: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Super Rare.name: Gladiator Beast Laquari
Super Rare.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, its original ATK becomes 2100. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Laquari".

Super Rare.name: Six Samurai United
Super Rare.desc: Each time a "Six Samurai" monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, place 1 Bushido Counter on this card (max. 2). You can send this card to the GY; draw 1 card for each Bushido Counter on this card.

Super Rare.name: Snowman Eater
Super Rare.desc: If this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target.

Super Rare.name: Spell Shattering Arrow
Super Rare.desc: Destroy as many face-up Spells your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each.
